problem: What is the order of the ordinary differential equation $y\frac{{\text{d}}^{6}y}{\text{d}{x}^{6}}+3x\frac{{\text{d}}^{3}y}{\text{d}{x}^{3}}={x}^{8}?$

feedback.problem: What is the order of the ordinary differential equation $\frac{{\text{d}}^{3}y}{\text{d}{x}^{3}}+5{y}^{2}\frac{{\text{d}}^{2}y}{\text{d}{x}^{2}}+3{y}^{5}=0?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The order of an ordinary differential equation (ODE) is the order of the highest derivative in the equation.

The highest derivative in the given ODE is $\frac{{\text{d}}^{3}y}{\text{d}{x}^{3}},$ which has order $3.$

Therefore, the order of the ODE is $3.$
